Some say I'm physically incapable of feeling shame.
The thrill of a good run is all I live for.
I often feel apathetic to most deaths and suffering.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Generosity. A gift like ours shouldn't be kept only to ourselves! (Good)
Individuality. The ruler of my own life is myself, I do what I want, not what some code wants. (Chaotic)
Own Code. I follow my own set of beliefs, esoteric as they may be, they were my choice. (Lawful)
Liberty. I just want to live my life in my own terms. (Any)
Luxury. Why should I hold back when I could feast day and night on these weaker beings? (Evil)
Secrecy. I'll lay low, they won't bother me if I don't bother them too much either. (Neutral)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I run with a posse of my own.
The Estate I left is still there, and they want me absolutely dead.
I'm known around small villages as a boogeyman.
There's a lovely hunter that just keeps trying to take me out, yet I just toy with them.
I've retained contact with code-abiding fiends that need someone to get their hands dirty at times.
I still hold the people from my human life dear.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I tend to be reckless, thinking I'll just die anyways.
I'm easily angered by lower beings talking to me.
My thirst for blood is greater than any other need I have.
There's no way I'll miss a chance to mock noblesse and the dainty sort.
I adore playing with my food, despite how dangerous it might be.
My life will be peaceful, and I often deal with those who discover my true nature gruesomely.

_.special: a trinket that once belonged to your Sire

background.name: Runaway Bloodbag

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Intimidation}, plus one from among {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Stealth}, {@skill Survival}, and {@skill Sleight of Hand}

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: One of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A tattered set of {@item Common Clothes|PHB|common clothes}, a broken pair of {@item Manacles|PHB|manacles}, a torn page from your former master's journal, and a pouch containing 15 gp

entries: You were nearly turned, then left for dead-half-made, half-ruined. Something that calls itself your master tried to make you theirs. Maybe it ambushed you on the road, maybe you were an adventurer who fell into the wrong crypt, or perhaps you were born into it-raised like cattle for the bite. Whatever the cause, the experience has warped your body and mind in ways no one should endure.

Now, you live in the space between lethargy and rage, your body never quite healing right, your sleep never truly restful. How did you escape your would-be master? What scars do you carry still-on your body, or in your soul? And when sleep comes, what horrors visit you then?

entries.name: Feature: Bloody Massacre
entries: You carry the lasting marks of your incomplete transformation-gory wounds, feverish eyes, unnatural paleness. Blood often stains your clothes, and few mistake you for anything but cursed. Once per short rest you gain a +2 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) checks made against creatures unfamiliar with what you are, provided they can see you and would reasonably be disturbed by your appearance. The DM may rule that seasoned adventurers or undead are immune to this effect.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: People often tend to describe me as shady or fidgety.
Sometimes I just stare into space and tune out.
Despite my appearance, I try my best to be gentle and kind.
I have fully embraced the monster I've become.
I often catch myself becoming much more enraged for what others would say is just a small slight.
There's no length I won't go for feeling safe.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Freedom. I will never be {@condition Restrained||restrained} up again. (Chaotic)
Revenge. I will tear anything that lays in my path towards my rightful vengeance, no matter what or who it is. (Evil)
Knowledge. Understanding what happened to me is all that matters now. (Any)
Caution. May what happened to me be a cautionary tale, as I will not allow it to happen to no one else. (Good)
Meaning. I don't know what I've turned into or who I did, yet I'm looking for that answer. (Neutral)
Penance. This all has been some curse for my past misdeeds, and I must dutifully atone for them. (Lawful)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I was the only survivor between all my peers when we got attacked. Guilt eats away at me every day.
I was raised for this. My parents always knew, and even they betrayed me in the end. For what? Why did they do this?
There was never a chance I would've suspected my old town's mayor, she was just so nice. I was wrong.
Someone saved me from my captor, I owe them my life.
There were others being used as cattle like me. I have to go back for them.
The one who did this to me was forced to. There's more to this, I'm sure of it.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: There is no calming me down when I get upset.
I fear I will never be the same.
Sometimes the violent instincts get to me.
I can barely speak right at times, the headache never goes away.
My dreams are plagued by the sights of who did this to me.
I can't stand my body anymore, and won't ever let someone see it ever again.

_.special: a tattered set of common clothes
a torn page from your former master's journal

background.name: Fanghunter

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Survival}, plus one from among {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Stealth}, {@skill Sleight of Hand}, {@skill Investigation}, and {@skill Intimidation}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@item Woodcarver's Tools|PHB|Woodcarver's tools} and one type of artisan's tools

items.name: Languages:
items.entry: One of your choice

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: Two wooden stakes, a {@item Dagger|PHB|dagger}, a set of {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB|traveler's clothes}, a necklace of garlic, and a pouch containing 14 gp

entries: You were either raised in a tradition of vampire hunters, taught never to sleep without a stake beneath your pillow-or you became one the hard way, when something with fangs nearly stole your life. Whatever your path, you've made it your mission to eliminate {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Bloodfiends} and their ilk from the world.

Fanghunters are dedicated, relentless, and superstitious. They study their prey, learn their patterns, and ensure that no creature of the night sleeps soundly. Some belong to secretive orders with ancient rites, while others work alone, driven by personal vendettas. How did you take up the fanghunt? What rituals do you follow before a kill? What do you fear more-the monsters, or what you've become to fight them?

entries.name: Feature: Hunter's Knowhow
entries: You know how to prepare for a hunt. During a long rest, if you have access to wood (such as from a forest or broken furniture) and woodcarver's tools, you can craft up to six wooden stakes as part of your light activity. Additionally, you have advantage on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks made to locate merchants, black markets, or craftsmen who sell vampire-hunting gear.

When you take this background, choose one of the following weapons: {@item Stake Crossbow|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Stake Crossbow} or {@item Serrated Hand-axe|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Serrated Axe}. You gain proficiency with the chosen weapon.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: I always knock on wood three times before doing anything.
Cleaning my weapons is how I relax.
Secrets are meant to be kept, lest the entire world panic.
I barely take anything seriously anymore, just so I can weather through the horrible things.
I adore telling tales of my hunts more than anything.
I hate staying still in one place, it's sickening.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Protection. I will protect those that can't protect themselves, making sure no village is unsafe to walk at night. (Good)
Obedience. I receive orders from my superiors, and eliminate the {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Bloodfiends} I am told to. No more, no less. (Lawful)
Self. I don't care about {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Bloodfiends} or Humans. I get rid of those that bother my personal life, and that's that. (Chaotic)
Dominance. I will subjugate all {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Bloodfiends} I meet. They will become weapons for my own schemes (Evil)

Patience. I do not hunt {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Bloodfiends}, for I might mistakenly wound innocents. I wait until I am the one hunted, for it to learn it was never the predator. (Neutral)
Tradition. I was told since a young age that this was what I needed to do. Every day, I toil in blood, both theirs and my own, and wonder whether that continues to be true. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: My family has done this for generations.
I run with a whole enclave, no one can escape our hunt.
There is a village that I'll never allow fiends in.
There was the one bastard that got away, but not for long.
All of my loved ones were murdered by a fiend.
I nearly got turned, yet in the wake of that I have gotten a taste for {@race Bloodfiend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Bloodfiend} blood instead.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: When I start something, I won't focus on anything else until it's done.
People call me paranoid. I say I'm well protected.
I can't stand the sight of gluttonous people or feasts.
Whispers tell me when something's wrong, it's my sixth sense.
No matter how much I clean my hands, I will never be clean.
There are particular beliefs and rituals to be done, and those who do not perform them are fools.

background.name: Flickering Hope

items.name: Skill Proficiencies:
items.entry: {@skill Survival}, plus one from among {@skill Athletics}, {@skill Acrobatics}, {@skill Insight}, {@skill Stealth}, and {@skill Intimidation}

items.name: Tool Proficiencies:
items.entry: One type of artisan's tools

items.name: Equipment:
items.entry: A keepsake from your old home or group, a set of worn {@item Traveler's Clothes|PHB|traveler's clothes}, a canteen of whiskey, a rusty {@item Dagger|PHB|dagger}, and a pouch containing 10 gp

entries: You might've been an adventurer or just a commoner, either way there's one thing that connects both: a full wipe-out of life. You've suffered great losses in a critical moment of your life, your family, your friends, comrades and faces who once smiled with your own. They might be hard to remember now, as they were taken in some horrible event that has left your heart struggling to beat ever since. What took everything away from me? Was it a reckless decision of your own? Do you wish for revenge? Is there still any going back to what once were?

entries.name: Feature: Light at the End of the Tunnel
entries: Death's embrace is one that you won't take lightly, as it has taken too much from you. You've braved through many a storm, and by now it only motivates you to keep living on, as such when you are below half your hit points you may add an {@dice 1d6} bonus to a roll. You must do this before rolling and you can only do this once per short rest.

entries.caption: Personality Trait
rows: Sometimes when I look away I see the faces of my fallen comrades.
I can never relax unless I write my days in a diary meant for someone who will never read it.
Sometimes I might focus too much on one thing and tune the world out.
There's always an itching feeling in my chest, like everything will happen again.
I should've died with everyone else.
All I want is to show others what I once had, so it's memory might never be forgotten.

entries.caption: Ideal
rows: Prevention. I'll make sure that what happened to me happens to no one else. (Good)
Oath. Carelessness costs us everything. I've developed a code of morals so I will never stray from the right path again. (Lawful)
Self. People call me obsessive, that I can't give a piece of mind to anyone else -- I'm simply focused on enacting my revenge. (Chaotic)
Revenge. Nothing will get in my way to burning every single thing that reminds me of my past. (Evil)
Abandon. There is nothing else for me to lose nor to gain. I'll just keep living on until I flicker out, that's all I wish for. (Neutral)
Perseverance. The past is ashes in the wind, but the ones I lost would want me to keep on, so that is what I will do. I will move past the ashes to become someone new. (Any)

entries.caption: Bond
rows: I keep a vial of the fuel used to burn down my home.
My comrade's weapons are all that remained, and sharpened they remain as well.
My old kingdom was raised to the ground, yet its echoes linger on in me.
I am haunted by those gone.
The bastard. That one bastard was the one who caused all this, I will find them and I will have my revenge.
A faction did this to me. It will cease existing and never be remembered when I've burned it all down.

entries.caption: Flaw
rows: I never let go of what I have. What if I lose it?!
Getting close to people just burns, and I'm done being scorched.
The fire in my chest is intense and easily lashes out at those close to me.
Everytime I close my eyes I see what happened.
All I think about is vengeance.
It was all my fault. No one else's. Everything is.

_.special: a keepsake from your old home or group
a set of worn traveler's clothes

spell.name: Summon Wartime Rainfall
entries: You crush the metallic casings in your hand and blow their dust upward to form a localized storm cloud that forms various crimson magic circles that pelt down bullet fire as if raindrops. Choose an area you can see within range, a cloud of bullet hail sprouts to cover a 30-ft. by 30-ft. cube centered at that point.

Any creature must pass a Dexterity saving throw whenever they start or end their turns within that area, suffering {@damage 2d12} piercing damage on a failure, or half on a success. These bullets come from every direction at once, causing Large or greater creatures to suffer one additional damage die as per each additional 5-ft. of space they occupy in a line. ( This only counts a line traced between the start and end of where a creature occupies, such as having Large creatures suffer an additional {@damage 1d12} piercing damage, or Huge ones suffering an additional {@damage 2d12} and so on. )

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d12} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Frontliner's Baton March

components.m: a glass shard from a broken picture holder

entries: You conjure forth a plume of reddish smoke that lingers on the feet of your target, spreading outwards with movement and reinvigorating spirits as if it were a flare to focus aim onto a single victorious future. The target gains an additional 15-ft. of movement speed until the end of their next turn. At the start of their turn they gain 2 Poise count and gain an additional 2 count for each friendly creature they first enter within 5-ft. of until the end of their turn. Creatures passed by this way gain an amount of Poise count at the end of the runner's turn equal to 2 + the amount of creatures passed by.

spell.name: Sprouting Strike

components.m: a seed or piece of bark

entries: You enchant and flick the seed for rapid growth after sticking to the target. You a ranged spell attack against a target creature within reach and dealing 1 piercing damage on a hit. As a Free Action you may take after planting a seed on the creature you may cause it to sprout into heavy vines that dig into the ground, trapping the creature in place until it is destroyed. A creature trapped this has their movement speed reduced to 0.
These vines have 20 Hit Points, an AC of 12 and are Vulnerable to fire and slashing damage. They naturally vanish after one hour, wherein the seed also grows permanently dormant if not sprouted.
You have Advantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth}) checks to hide the casting of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the vines Hit Points increase by 10 and AC increase by 1 for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Blooming Manifestation

components.m: a handful of petals or leaves

entries: You toss three petals into the air and have the winds guide them to be buried in different unoccupied spots in the ground, causing them to quickly bloom into small branches that twitch and grow with unstable magic. Whenever a hostile creature moves into or around 5-ft. of one of these Branches, the Branch quickly moves to whip and grab at them, absorbing their willpower for sustenance. That creature must pass a Dexterity saving throw or fall {@condition Prone}, take {@damage 2d6} bludgeoning damage and 3 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count. On a success, the Branch simply whiffs and remains in place.

Upon hitting a creature a Branch blooms and becomes a regular, yet beautiful plant. All others that have not bloomed simply shrivelling up and dying after the spell's duration passes or your Concentration is broken.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create an additional Branch for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Rattling Smite

components.m: a scrap of paper with a symbol that you can peer into and see yourself

entries: You start channelling your magic into your weapons to have it shake and build up a horrible vibration. The next target creature you hit with a melee weapon attack suffers {@damage 1d8} additional thunder damage and three {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count.

spell.name: Shock Bubbles
entries: You conjure three spheres of pure vibrating energy that bend and break the shape of space around them.

You perform three ranged attacks against one target creature within range, or divide each attack towards different targets. On a hit, the target creature suffers three {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} counts and takes {@damage 2d6} thunder damage. If three spheres hit the same target, it suffers from {@variantrule Tremor Burst|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you create an additional Sphere for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Time for Harvest
entries: You shoot out a razor-sharp vine coated in flowers that was bathed in your blood for its initial growth, and let it sink into a target creature to drain them of their life.

You perform a ranged spell attack against a creature within reach that you can see. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 2d12} piercing damage and have the seed sink into their being. For the spell's duration, whenever the target suffers damage they suffer additional piercing damage equal to your spell attack modifier and you recover Hit Points equal to half that amount, rounded down.

If you end your turn more than 60-ft. away from the linked creature, the vine connecting you both is severed and the spell ends early. The vine itself has an AC of 22 and 42 Hit Points, being vulnerable to fire and necrotic damage. Whenever targeted by another creature for a melee attack, the attacking creature suffers {@damage 1d8} piercing damage as its thorns grow to feed.

spell.name: Curse of Eroding Will
entries: You deliver a mind-shattering curse to another creature, forcing them to pass a Charisma Saving Throw or suffering from their will rapidly eroding in a horrible lapse into dread. On a failure, they suffer a negative modifier to their attack rolls, ability checks and Strength and Wisdom saving throws for each 5-ft. of movement speed they have reduced and 9 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count.

Additionally, this breach in their resolve causes them to lose 5-ft. of movement speed per each 3 {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count they are suffering from, to a maximum loss of 20-ft. of movement. This negative modifier cannot surpass a -3 either.

spell.name: Heart-Breaking Smite
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon's figure distorts to seem cracked and its material slowly melting. The attack deals an additional {@damage 2d6} cold damage to the target and inflicts half the damage dealt ( rounded down. ) as counts of {@condition Sinking|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@damage 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Weaver's Wright
entries: You fold the piece of cloth and consume it, then point to up to six creatures within reach. Each of those creatures is wreathed by a woven mantle of white that protects them from whatever is to come, granting them {@dice 2d10} + your Spellcasting modifier's worth of Temporary Hit Points.

While these Temporary Hit Points remain, any damage taken that exceeds their value is reduced instead to become however many Temporary Hit Points remain, as the mantle takes the brunt of any attack before it can be directed at its wearer.
Ex: If a cloth-wearing creature is dealt 26 damage and they have 15 Temporary Hit Points, they instead only take 15 damage from that source.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the amount of Temporary Hit Points granted increases by {@dice 2d10} for each other slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Baleful Brand

components.m: a crumpled paper with your genuine hopes and dreams

entries: You clasp your hands together and wring writing out of thin air, manifesting your magic into solidified threats that erode all it touches. You then point toward a creature within reach, performing a ranged spell attack against them. On a hit, the target suffers {@damage 6d10} psychic damage and suffers from their heart being slowly eroded. Until the end of the targets turn after their next turn, anytime it would suffer damage it suffers an additional 4 points of acid damage that cannot be reduced by any means. Furthermore, whenever the target ends their turn ( including the turn where this effect ends ) they suffer 10 acid damage that also cannot be reduced in any way.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may choose one additional target within reach for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: First Lightlock
entries: You crush the petal under your thumb to have its remains form a glowing sigil of a petal behind your shoulder, simultaneously creating increasing gashes of concentrated light. You perform a ranged spell attack roll against a target creature within reach, dealing {@damage 2d6} slashing damage on a hit.

Each time you cast this spell, you may use your Action during your next turn to spend a Spell Slot of one level greater to cast this spell at a greater Unlock rank, causing additional effects to trigger as per the following:

entries.name: Unlock II
entries: The second time this spell is cast you perform an additional ranged spell attack roll against the target, dealing {@damage 3d8} piercing damage on a hit. You have advantage on this roll if you hit the first attack.

entries.name: Unlock III
entries: The third time this spell is cast, the slashing damage it deals increases to {@damage 3d6} and the piercing damage it deals increases to {@damage 4d8}.
After using any greater Unlock rank, you may spend it's corresponding Spell Slot Level to cast this spell and make use of it's corresponding effects until the end of your next long rest.

entries.name: Singleton
entries: After causing the effects of Unlock III, you regain one first-level spell slot.

spell.name: Sense Quarry

components.m: a slip of paper wishing for peace

entries: You press your hands together and allow the slip of paper to be burnt, with its ashes forming a wave that washes around you, highlighting the silhouette of any creature within range that is actively fighting or harbours immediate hostile intent toward another creature.
You can discern what or who a creature is if you are familiar with their general shape but may not determine the target of their hostility.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the range increases by 100-ft. for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Binding Chains
entries: You reach out your hand toward a target within reach, swirling your arm as five flashes of light appear around them and soon transforming into burning bright chains that bind them. You choose one target within reach to perform a Strength saving throw, becoming bound for the duration on a failure. They may re-attempt this saving throw at the end of their turns.
While bound, the target has their movement speed halved and a negative modifier to their Attack Rolls, Dexterity and Constitution saving throws equal to your proficiency bonus.

entries.name: Singleton
entries: The target also suffers the same negative modifier to Strength and Wisdom saving throws.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you may target an additional creature within range for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Combustion Snap
entries: You snap your fingers together, causing a burst of flame to abruptly erupt at the surface of another creature's body. You make one ranged spell attack against that creature, dealing {@damage 1d4} fire damage and 1 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count on a hit.

You create more than one burst when you reach higher levels: two bursts at 5th level, three bursts at 11th level and four bursts at 17th level. You can cause these bursts at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate attack roll for each target, hitting or missing all bursts dedicated to the same target depending on the result.

If you could deal additional {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count on hits through external effects, you may only deal up to half your proficiency bonus' worth of the count per burst instead.

spell.name: Fan the Flame
entries: You mystically extend the wing in your hand to become a blazing fan and then beat it, causing a great scorching gale to overtake the area within range. All creatures of your choice must pass a Constitution saving throw or suffer 1 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count and then have all failing creature's count of the Condition be summed up and then divided equally amongst them.

spell.name: Butterfly's Dragpath
entries: You make a rift in space appear at a point within range, to where a massive blazing talon bears down and drags through a 30-ft. long, 10-ft. wide line of your choice. This area is engulfed in flame for the duration, causing any creature inside that area to suffer 2 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count whenever they end or start their turn atop the area.

This flame cannot be put out by non-magical water or wind, but will be extinguished by effects such as the {@spell gust of wind} spell. Surmountable fuel may be thrown into the fire as a Bonus Action, such as an Oil (Flask), causing it to rage on stronger and deal an additional {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count whenever the Condition is applied. The same happens through spells such as {@spell grease} being cast atop this zone, also effectively expanding its area to cover wherever it is covered by the {@spell grease} spell.
This fire may deal a total of 6 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count per turn start or end.

spell.name: Broken Match
entries: You lit the match between your fingers and use it to draw out four symbols of floating ember in the air, connecting them to up to three {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burning} creatures within range. You then strike through all these symbols with the match, instantly making it and the target creatures burst in flame.

These target creatures instantly suffer the effects of their {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count twice, halving their count each time they suffer it. If a target is suffering from {@condition Tremor - Scorch|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, you may choose to trigger {@condition Tremor - Scorch|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} once instead.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the targets must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer an amount burn count after triggering the Condition equal to three times each slot level above 3rd on a failure.

spell.name: Candlesetting
entries: You conjure three red candles in unoccupied spaces of your choice within range that float in the air as if they have been affixed to empty space. These look like strips of tallow interwoven, and may be alight by a creature hitting them with a melee attack ( They have an AC of 14 ) or by spending their Bonus Action to do so.

After being set alight, these candles' bursting flames cling and surround the weapons of creatures of your choice within 15-ft. of each respective candle, having them deal one {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count on melee weapon attack hits for the duration.

Lit candles are small sized objects that have an amount of Maximum Hit Points equal to 4 times the spell slot level used to cast this spell. Upon falling below one Hit Point, the candle becomes unlit and must be lit again. These candles have a +0 modifier to saving throws except for Constitution and Charisma, to which they use a bonus modifier equal to half the spell slot level used to cast this spell. They also Resist fire damage and are Vulnerable to cold and thunder damage.

A creature may benefit from dealing up an amount of additional {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count from this spell's effects equal to 2 plus the spell slot level used to cast this spell.

If this spell is cast at 6th level or higher you may meld up to two Candles into the same space, causing them to become a pillar of tallow and flame that grants two {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} additional count instead of one and have a range of 30-ft. instead. These Candles count as medium sized objects and have Maximum Hit Points equal to 8 times the spell slot level.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you summon an additional Candle for each spell slot used above 3rd.

spell.name: Cascading Cataclysm
entries: You click your tongue in a frequency that causes flames to burst out and rage in a blazing howl. One {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burning} creature within reach must pass a Dexterity saving throw or combust violently, suffering an amount of {@damage d8} fire damage equal to half their current {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count ( To a maximum of {@damage 6d8} ) and suffering the same value of {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count, ( Max. 6 ) or half that damage and count.

All creatures within 15-ft. of the initial target must pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer half that damage and count. If the initial target failed, you may choose to have one already {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burning} creature within that reach make a Wisdom saving throw instead, causing them to explode on a failure and suffer the same as the initial effects of this spell.

You may make creatures explode in this way for an amount of times equal to the Spell Slot Level spent to cast this spell, and must always target a creature who has not yet attempted this spell's Wisdom saving throw to explode.

spell.name: Searing Birdcage

components.m: The burnt feather of a goose

entries: You invoke the spirit of a flaming goose that manifests above a target creature within reach and have it then judge their sins. The creature must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer {@damage 4d4} fire damage and 4 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count.
If the creature has committed any of the following since the start of their last turn, they suffer additional effects upon failing this saving throw:

items: Killed or knocked another creature {@condition Unconscious}.
Cast a spell by spending a spell slot.
Spoke ill or disrespected the core beliefs of a non-Evil aligned deity.

entries: Upon committing any of these sins, the creature suffers {@damage 4d12} fire damage instead as a cage of searing feathers comes to bind them. They also suffer 8 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count instead, have their movement speed reduced to 0-ft. and a -3 negative modifier to Dexterity saving throws until the end of their next turn.
If they have committed two or more of these sins, they have Disadvantage on the saving throw.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may select an additional target for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Pyre of Prophecy
entries: Through whispers of shattered texts and precognition of old you cause a burning pyre to burst out from an unnocupied 10-ft. by 10-ft. space within reach, rising to stand tall and cause life to burn bright.

This Pyre is a large object that has an AC of 17, Resistance to Fire and Radiant damage and is Vulnerable to cold damage. It does not benefit from this Resistance toward suffering {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} damage.

The Pyre demands the extinguishment of all around it, constantly emanating scorching air that causes all creatures within 30-ft. of it to suffer 2 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} at the end of their turns. At the start of a creatures turn they must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer 6 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count if they are inside this area.

Furthermore, this Pyre makes burns inside its reach feel like one is being pressed against hell itself, increasing {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} damage to {@dice d8|d8s} instead of {@dice d4|d4s} and {@condition Tremor - Scorch|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}'s end of turn damage to {@dice d8|d8s} as well. The Condition's burst damage becomes {@dice d10|d10s} instead of {@dice d6|d6s}.

At the end of your turns, the Pyre gains 2 {@condition Burn|TheUndertomesGeneralRules|Burn} count per creature inside it's area, to a minimum of 2, and suffers the Condition's damage at the start of your subsequent turns.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may select an additional target for each slot level above 5th.

spell.name: Crown of Penitence

components.m: a diamond worth at least 300 gp, a thorn to be embedded into fingers

entries: "One Sin and Hundreds of Good Deeds awaits humanity's sin." You start chanting in a low voice, your eyes turning into a hazy gray as your gaze remains not on the material around you, but on the spiritual. You gaze into your peers sins and guilts, and may absolve them, even if momentarily to bring forth a moment of respite, for recognizing the wrong doing is the first step toward penitence. As a bonus action on their turns, any creature beside you may speak aloud a sin that they've commited in which they feel guilty about, such as a devout breaking a tenet of their deity or a war veteran declaring their regret for taking the life of an innocent.

For each sin confessed this way, add a +1 to a Penitence Tracker. Creatures may individualy confess up to three sins until the spell ends. After confessing, the creature takes 1 point of piercing damage as a Crown of Thorns manifests around their head.

The Penitence Tracker may not exceed 9 Points unless a Heavy Sin is uttered. For each 3 points in the Penitence Tracker, each creature who has confessed and yourself feel your shoulders get much lighter, granting a cumulative +1 to all your rolls for the spells duration.
Otherwise, upon reaching certain thresholds on the Penitence Tracker, you may perform the actions on the following table by spending your Action. You may only perform any of these once.

entries.caption: Penitence Actions
rows: {@b Penitence Through Pain.} All the confessing creatures take {@damage 3d8} piercing damage as their crown digs into their scalp, a searing yet liberating pain encroaching through their body. Those who would be reduced to below one hit point remain at one hit point instead, and all gain {@dice 5d8} temporary hit points, in addition to resistance to non-magical piercing, bludgeoning and slashing damage.

{@b Bring Forth the Guilty.} You may choose up to three non-confessing creatures within the spells range and ask them to confess a sin of the same weight as your fellows. After responding or not, they must perform a Charisma saving throw or suffer the weight of their sins through a lightning bolt falling through the skies and onto them, dealing {@damage 4d8} lightning damage on a failure, or half on a success. Creatures who have confessed have advantage on this Saving Throw.

{@b Rain Absolution.} A mighty downpour comes to wash away the dread and mistakes of old, offering a moment's respite to the penitent's souls and reminding the unrepentant of their grace. All creatures within the area must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or be buffeted heavily by the rain, taking {@damage 8d8} bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half on a success. Confessers fail the saving throw automatically, yet instead of taking damage are healed by half the amount.

entries: When confessing, a creature may instead of confessing only what weighs upon them, they may confess their heaviest sin, such as being the fault for the death of a city or having betrayed their loved ones in ways they can never go back. The DM has final say if the sin is heavy enough or not, yet sins confessed in this manner are worth 3 Penitence points.

If the Penitence tracker reaches 15 Points with only heavy confessions, you may utter a final sin of your own authorship. Upon doing so, a bright light encompasses the area around the spell, it's duration is reset, all those who confessed are reduced to one hit point and cannot be knocked {@condition Unconscious} until the spell ends, as the hefty weight of the crown on each confesser's head doesn't seem to budge, yet the will to acknowledge past mistakes makes it all the more bearable, the thorns starting to bud in small, red flowers.

spell.name: Fairies' Care

components.m: a sprinkle of pixie dust on ham

entries: You bring forth a cluster of small green faeries that surround a target creature within range, they gently frollick and fly around them, giggling as they heal their wounds. At the start of that creature's turn, it regains {@damage 1d4+1} hit points. If they would regain hit points through any other means while Fairies' Care is active, the cluster of faeries turns on them, ravenously biting away at them before dispersing.
The spell ends early and the creature who was once benefitting from them takes an amount of d8 piercing damage equal to the amount of turns they were healed by Fairies' Care.

spell.name: Arms of the Spider
entries: You conjure the disembodied gigantic, spindly legs of a spider near a target creature within range. It must pass a Dexterity saving throw or suffer from the spider perfectly weaving a Cocoon around most of its body, rendering it {@condition Grappled||grappled} until the Cocoon is broken. On a success, the creature takes {@damage 2d4} piercing damage as the legs nick its body from the rampant movement.
The Cocoon has 50 hit points, 12 AC and weakness to fire damage. After being destroyed the Cocoon slowly crumbles into white dust.

spell.name: Mutual Exsanguination

components.m: The blood of your own body

entries: You either deliver a nasty cut to one of your palms that soon closes as blood seeps out to the floor, or you simply sacrifice your blood magically to summon two gangly pale arms around you, reaching around to grasp at one creature of your choice within range. When you cast this spell, you take an amout of your hit die in slashing damage equal to the level you cast it on, and the target creature must pass a Constitution Saving Throw or take double the amount of die in slashing damage, as slices and gashes start being formed as the hands hold them, then crumbling to dust in the end of the spell. The amount of Hit Die spendable at once is equal to the spell slot level this spell is cast on.
At Higher Levels: For every second spell slot level spent above 2nd level, starting at 4th, you may choose an additional target for this spell.

spell.name: Crown of Metal
entries: You gaze upon a creature within the reach of this spell and have them believe that a disease has overtaken their head, slowly turning it into metal. The target creature must pass a Wisdom Saving throw or be affected by the spell, their perception distorted to feel the pressure of their forehead slowly turning into metal, and the rest of their head soon to follow suit. At the start of each of their turns, the afflicted creature must spend one of their attacks to bang their head against the nearest solid surface, taking {@damage 2d8} bludgeoning damage as they desperately try to free their head from the metallic ringing that will never stop.

If they would deal damage to another creature through a melee attack, they also take {@dice 1d8} damage as their desperate flailing ends up hurting them back. The target may retry the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, being cured on a success.

spell.name: Cacophonous Gramophone

components.m: An actual Gramophone and a chunk off of a broken meteor.

entries: You conjure forth a haunting melody to play out of a phantom gramophone, its sound is usually almost alien in nature, and you can choose which creatures can suffer its true melody. All creatures beside yourself within the area must pass a Charisma Saving throw on the start of their turn or suffer {@damage 2d4} psychic damage and suffer a -2 penalty to their Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws until the start of their next turn. On a success, they only take half the psychic damage.
When you cast this spell, you may choose up to three creatures to automatically pass the Saving Throw caused by this spell.

spell.name: Aberrant Apuncture
entries: Good arrows pierce the heart and make a body cease functions, great arrows pierce the brain and make a person be less of themselves. You invoke a giant arrow, tendril or lance of dark, cosmic energy which ebbs and flows with noises that you can never quite understand. Make a ranged spell attack against one creature within range, on a hit, the creature takes {@damage 1d10} piercing damage plus {@damage 2d4} cold damage, additionally the creature has their current feelings emptied away and replaced with a momentary void.

It cannot feel that feeling until they are cured by a spell such as {@spell greater restoration|PHB|Greater Restoration} or Remove curse, as an example, a berzerking barbarian who suffers this will not be able to feel their anger until then. The creature suffers disadvantage to any skill checks that would be acting upon such a feeling, following the example a creature without its anger would have disadvantage for {@skill Intimidation} checks, or a creature without its adoration could have disadvantage imposed to it when attempting to Persuade another. This creature feels a void upon their chest until cured.

spell.name: Landshark Lunge
entries: You have learned how to mold earth in a frightening manner, yet to do so, you must use your entire body. As part of your action when you cast this spell, you dive headfirst into the ground as if it were a liquid substance, until the end of your turn you gain a Burrowing speed equal to your walking speed. On the end of your turn, you are flung back to the surface on the nearest empty 5-foot space, when you do this, you may cause a crash of sharp rocks to appear up alongside you, resembling the sharp teeth of a shark's maw.

Any creatures within a 10-feet radius of that space must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take {@damage 2d10} piercing damage. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Bones of Meat
entries: You conjure forth a small white flower bearing green fruit in an empty 5-foot space within reach, and it takes root deep down below. When a creature first moves into this flowers space, the roots start unwinding into a messy mass of flesh and teeth, flinging itself up to crash down violently at its assailer. This creature must pass a Dexterity Saving throw or take {@damage 4d12} slashing damage and be {@condition Frightened} of you for the next minute, taking half damage on a success.

After being stepped on, the flower is trampled and the space may be moved into freely and safely. The {@condition Frightened} creature may also attempt a Charisma saving throw to break free from the condition at the end of its turns. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d12} for each slot level above 6th.

spell.name: The Lie of Promised Love
entries: You open your arms towards a creature, using your magic to nudge their mind just so their memories jumble up to have you resemble some old friend or lover, either way a crashing wave of nostalgia and want washes over them, and the desire for a hug is all thats left on their mind. You may choose one creature within reach of this spell, they must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or be forced to use their reaction to run towards the nearest unnocupied 5-feet space within 5-feet of yourself. Upon their arrival, you coax them into a tight embrace, and using the weight of their emotions, you crush the creature within the hug, dealing {@damage 6d8} bludgeoning damage and leaving them {@condition Grappled||grappled} by you, then ending the effect.

A creature that is immune to being {@condition Charmed||charmed} passes this Saving Throw automatically. At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 4th.

spell.name: Obsession
entries: You whisper a short string of words into another neutral or friendly creatures ear, often disguised within a phrase or a question and laden with arcane energy. This creature must pass a Charisma Saving throw or be enchanted to become fully obsessed with the main subject of what you said, such as an object, a topic or a person, this becoming their hyperfixation or object of desire for the duration of the spell. A creature enchanted like this will act upon their obsession in increasing levels, on the first five days they may, depending on their personality, have fully researched a topic without having nearly enough sleep, or even stalked the person deemed as their desire, yet they will become desperate and anxious on the sixth and seventh days if they do not acquire their object of desire or make a discovery within the topic of their knowledge.

During these last days, they become hostile to any creatures that might go against their will. In addition, if they have a chance before the sixth day to acquire their object of desire in any manner, they must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or immediately become more deranged, trying their hardest to obtain it earlier.

spell.name: Star Shower

components.m: A word spoken in a hearts confidence

entries: With a word breathed into the palm of your hands, a hail of showers materializes in glimmering light above your back, shooting away to bathe an area within 60-feet. You may point to any space within reach, and a hail of shooting stairs falls down upon a 15-foot circle around that point. Any creature within reach must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take {@damage 3d4} force damage, taking half on a success.

Any creatures who fails this saving throw has a star crash and crumble over them, causing them to glow in a bright light that covers a 30-feet sphere around them. The entire area is also covered in bright lights that cover 30-feet around itself. When you cast this spell, you may choose to deal no damage.
At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 2nd, it deals another {@damage 2d4} force damage per slot spent above 2nd level.

spell.name: Bestow Serenity
entries: You conjure a handful bright pearls around you, all glowing with an aura of serenity all around them. You may choose up to three willing creatures within range to bestow these pearls to, for the duration, they heal for {@damage 2d8} hit points at the start of their turns as the pearl attaches to their armor, clothing or weapon as if it were always there, and the creatures feel a calm upon their shoulders, additionally granting them advantage on saving throws against becoming {@condition Frightened||frightened}. If a creature would leave the range of this spell, the pearl cracks as its connection is betrayed, having the creature take an amount of d8 of psychic damage equal to how many were used for their healing so far.

When this spells duration is finished or you dismiss it as a bonus action, the pearls slowly turn to a sugary tasting dust. At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 2nd, it heals an additional {@damage 1d8} hit points per turn per spell slot above 2nd.

spell.name: Birth Friendship
entries: You make a new friend burst from rotting flesh and bone. Choose a corpse within reach; for the casting duration, its chest slowly swells into a cocoon, its heart growing until it pops, a {@creature Gift Friend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon} slithering out of the chasm left behind. The corpse is left utterly mangled, not even edible anymore.

The {@creature Gift Friend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon} remains friendly to you as long as you create no more {@creature Gift Friend|TheUndertomesProjectMoon|Gift Friends}. If you do so, the older of the two becomes jealous, hostile, and uncontrollable.

spell.name: Gift of an Broken Heart
entries: Sometimes you just know when someone feigns niceness, or when to call it quits with the whole friends thing, just put an end to it. You raise an open palm towards a creature you can see within reach, a beating, wrapped cartoon heart appearing over it. The creature must pass a Charisma saving throw or be forced to accept the gift.

A creature who accepted the gift has the heart you made sewn into their skin, above their own, being able to be seen even through their clothes as if there were nothing there. It remains for up to three turns, its beat becoming faster and faster with each passing turn. On the start of the creatures first turn, it is disoriented by a deep despair settling into their heart, suffering a -1 to all rolls.

On the start of their second turn, this despair starts wrapping its fingers across their heart, it suffering then a -2 to all rolls and having its movement speed halved. On the start of their third turn, they must attempt a Charisma saving throw once more at disadvantage. On a failure, their heart breaks, taking {@damage 7d10} piercing damage, and suffering a -3 to all rolls for the next minute, as they are overcome with the weight of oblivion settling onto their chest.
At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 4th, heartbreak deals {@dice 1d10} additional damage per spell slot cast above 4th.

spell.name: Wickerman's Brambles

components.m: A living leech you must swallow

entries: Not only skin can be turned into bark, nor will only it be bitten into by flame. Choose one creature within range, they are forced to pass a Constitution Saving Throw or have their veins slowly start to turn into wood. The searing pain from such causes them to be unable to focus well on anything, taking a -3 penalty to their attack rolls and Saving Throws.

This effect ends early if they take fire or lightning damage, as the wood inside their body rapidly catches onto a blazing inferno, causing the creature to take damage from that source as if it were vulnerable to it, or resistance if it was immune to these damage types, also taking an additional {@dice 3d8} damage of the respective type. At Higher Levels: When this spell is cast at a level higher than 5th, it deducts an additional -1 to the total penalty and deals an additional {@dice 2d8} damage by each second spell slot above 5th. ( 7th level and 9th level ).

spell.name: Spread Lean Wings
entries: Even the earth must take to the air at times, all to reach its very own garden of Eden. You crush the bramble between your fingers, its thorny length becoming much larger, covering both of your hands in wings that quickly extend outward in an explosion of spikes. All creatures within a 15-feet radius of yourself must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or take {@damage 5d8} piercing damage and suffer 3 stacks of {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} {@condition Bleed|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, or only taking half the damage on a success.

spell.name: Conductors Orders
entries: You pool up arcane energies in a small chromatic aberration within the broken lightbulb, which you hold up. Choose a creature within range and between green light or red light. On a red light, the target creature must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or have their senses overtaken by a blinding red light, having their maximum walking speed reduced in half.
A green light however grants the creature a bonus to their walking speed equal to half their maximum current speed.

spell.name: Wind-Up Clock of Damocles

components.m: the minute hand of a pocketwatch

entries: The sounds of a clock ticking down can become infernal, and you're here to bring hell, after all. You point to a creature that you can see within range, it must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or suffer from perceiving a giant, sharpened clock hand dangling above their head, nearly dropping. This clock hand cannot be broken and will fall if the target creature fails to wind up the clock.

For the duration, whenever this creature is hit by an attack, it must perform a Concentration Check, and on a failure the clock hand falls as they miss their chance to wind-up the clock. The clock hand deals {@damage 6d10} piercing damage and inflicts the effects of the Slow spell to the target creature automatically, lasting for a minute. The clock hand may be dispelled through the {@spell dispel magic|PHB|Dispel Magic} spell or through breaking your concentration, and if the creature does not trigger the hand to fall during your spell's duration, it simply cracks and explodes into harmless golden dust.

spell.name: Salvation Smite
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon burns like a lit lamp. The attack deals an extra {@damage 2d6} radiant damage to the target, and a further {@dice 2d6} if they are below half their maximum hit points. This attack cannot be non-lethal and after killing a creature, they cannot be revived by means below a {@spell true resurrection|PHB|True Ressurection} or Wish spells, as their soul is viciously severed from the body.
At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 2nd.

spell.name: Sultus Justitia
entries: Summary judgement is in order, despite the veredict. You summon an arcane circle along the surface covered by this spell's range, indiscernible court-room chatter echoing out. Choose up to three creatures within reach, they must pass a Charisma Saving Throw or have ropes of darkness fall from the sky and strangle them by the neck, hoisting them up 5- feet into the air.

While hanging, these creatures suffer 1 level of Exhaustion at the start of their turn and having their movement speed reduced to 0 feet. To become free from this, the rope holding their neck must be cut. It has an AC of 14 and 50 hit points, alongside having vulnerability to fire and slashing damage.
The strangled creature has disadvantage to attacks targetting their own rope. Upon being set free, the creatures hanged recover from half their total Exhaustion, rounded up.

spell.name: Devour the Moon

components.m: the removed upper teeth of a wolf

entries: You manifest the giant disembodied head of a scar-covered wolf to bite down on a creature. Choose a creature within range, it and all other creatures around 5-feet of it must pass a Dexterity check or take {@damage 4d4} piercing damage on failure, with the creature chosen also taking an additional {@damage 4d4} piercing damage and being {@condition Restrained} for the spells duration, unless the maw is destroyed or you lose concentration. The Wolf's Maw has an AC of 8 and 60 hit points.
It has weakness to silvered weapons and resistence to non-magical piercing, slashing and bludgeoning damage.

spell.name: Orb of Balance

components.m: a rock carved into an infinite spiral

entries: Everything as its place in the grand scheme of thing, and for a moment you can condense both positive and negative energy in a sphere to ordain anothers place, or misplacement for that fact. Choose a creature within range, as the sphere zips around the battlefield quickly shifting from place to place until it crashes onto the target creature. It must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or suffer {@damage 4d6} necrotic damage plus {@damage 3d8} radiant damage, or half on a success.

In addition, on a failure, the energies within the creatures body become mismatched. The next time the creature would be healed, roll {@dice 1d4}. On a result of 2-3, the creature is healed like usual, on a 1 it receives no healing at all, and on 4 it heals by double what it would be.

On the next time the creature would take damage, roll {@dice 1d4}, following the same order as healing, with the difference that it either takes no damage, normal damage or double damage depending on the roll instead of being healed.

spell.name: Greetings from Broken Bone
entries: Great things take time and patience, such as saying hello to a person for the first time, to make it memorable. You kneel in preparation, channeling a necrotic power to the palm of your hands. When you cast this spell, you cannot move away from the space you're in until the start of your next turn.

Choose a direction within 5-feet of you, of where a 10-feet wide and 30-feet long line will form. At the start of your next turn, the spell goes off with a great stream of broken, sharpened bones shooting foward, all creatures within the lines area must pass a Dexterity Saving Throw or suffer {@damage 8d10} necrotic damage plus {@damage 4d4} piercing damage, or half on a success. Additionally, they can't recover lost hit points until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Levels:This spells damage increases by {@damage 1d10} necrotic damage and {@damage 1d4} piercing damage when cast at 6th level, and proportionaly increases by additional die on each level above 6th.

spell.name: Assimilate Shell
entries: The body is nothing but a skin to be worn over the flesh, and clothing like that is meant to be switched every once in a while. You conjure a ritual to wear another creature's skin by providing their fresh corpse, it must be dead for less than a week. During the ritual, you etch arcane symbols in both your and their body, chanting all the while.

After this spell is done, you phase into their body and gain +1 to your Charisma score if theirs was higher. You gain any abilities and features the creature had, including inheriting its maximum hit points as temporary hit points, which cannot be restored when your shell is damaged. While wearing your shell, you inherently can mimic their usual tendencies and speech, gaining advantage on any checks to pass as them.
If your temporary hit points during this are reduced below 1, the shell violently bursts in an explosion of gore, revealing your true self.

spell.name: Hollow Words
entries: Even words can haunt a creature to their core. You choose a creature within range to suffer a psychic onslaught. They must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or take {@damage 2d8} psychic damage and suffer from the Panicked condition, or just take half damage on a success.
Higher Levels: You may choose an additional target for this spell when its cast on every second level above 2nd, such as having two targets at 4th.

spell.name: First Trumpet
entries: The sound of duty is riveting, awe-inspiring, and hard to manage. As a reaction to when combat starts, you may tap into that pool of inspiration to coat an area with fanfare and the song of trumpets. Choose up to four creatures in the spells range.

You and the chosen creatures gain a +2 to your Initiative modifier and for the duration of the spell have a +1 to hit on the first attack done during your turn. At Higher Levels: For each second spell level spent for this spell, add an additional +1 to your Initiative modifier and a +1 to hit. Ex: Casting this spell at 4th level grants a +3 to Initiative and a +2 to hit.

spell.name: Cosmic Regurgitation
entries: There should be no relent from the force of gravity, as its law will be imposed onto every single being under the sun. You tap into that universal rule, violently flooding a creature with your arcane energy and pulling them. Choose one creature within range, it must pass a Strength Saving Throw or be hoisted up into the air, becoming unable to move.

As part of your action when you cast this spell and its target fails its Saving Throw, you hurl them through the air to any space within 60-feet of yourself. If they would land on the floor, they take {@damage 4d8} bludgeoning damage. If they would land on another creature, the other creature must pass a Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 4d12} bludgeoning damage as well, with the floating target taking the same value of damage.

spell.name: Golden Surveillance
entries: Being subtle is a luxury, one for those who don't fear being feared themselves. You summon hundreds of floating golden eyes that clump towards the top of buildings and corners, they are tiny creatures with 4 hit points and an AC of 12, their stealth modifier is +4. These eyes will instinctively attempt to hide themselves as best they can while settling to cover the whole area of the spell, yet are not {@condition Invisible||invisible} and any other creature may perceive them with a succesful {@skill Perception} check against them.

As a bonus action, you may tap into the web of arcana to peer through the eyes, also hearing anything within 60-feet of them. While you do this, you are considered {@condition Blinded||blinded} and {@condition Deafened||deafened} to your current surroundings, but gain a +3 modifier to {@skill Perception} and {@skill Investigation} checks to survey the area or look for something inside it. At Higher Levels: If this spell is cast using a 9th level spell slot, its range increases by 300 feet.

spell.name: Forest Purifying Light

components.m: The torn wing of a bird.

entries: Nothing will dare harm you, not when armageddon is brought upon their house. When you cast this spell, choose a creature to be engulfed by encroaching light, which makes shadows it creates move as if they were alive. The target must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or take {@damage 12d8} radiant damage and suffer a level of Exhaustion, as the light exhonerates them of their will to live.

If the target passes this Saving Throw, they instead take half damage and automatically pass any further Saving Throws against this spell for the next day. If this damage kills a creature, you may choose an additional creature to become a target, forcing them to attempt the same Wisdom Saving Throw, taking a further {@damage 2d8} radiant damage per previously killed target. This spell may be reused only 2 times per turn.
At Higher Levels: : If this spell was cast using a 9th level spell slot, it deals an additional {@damage 2d8} radiant damage and may be reused 2 more times.

spell.name: Sickening Sludge
entries: You invoke a gangrenous stream of black liquid to be spewed in a 15-feet long long, 15-feet wide cone starting from any point of your choice within reach. Any creatures in that area must pass a Dexterity Saving throw or be covered in the dark liquid. On a failure, the afflicted creatures suffer {@damage 3d8} acid damage at the beginning of their turns and suffer a -2 modifier to their Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws, alongside a -3 penalty to Charisma checks and Saving Throws.
This effect lasts until concentration is broken, the spell is dismissed or the afflicted creature coats their body in water.

spell.name: Land of Smiles
entries: Sickness and disease come in many forms, sometimes that form is elation. Choose a point within range, a viscous black bud of a plant appears in that spot, quickly bursting into dark fluid that covers a 15-foot radius around it, turning the area into difficult terrain and forcing any creatures within to pass a Charisma Saving throw or have their movement speed halved until they start their turn outside the difficult terrain as their thoughts are assaulted by an eery elation.

spell.name: Paradisiac Rapture
entries: Have you ever wondered what would happen if you crushed the will of a creature from the inside out? Choose a creature that you can see within range, it takes {@damage 4d8} radiant damage and must make a Charisma ssaving throw. On a failed save, the creature's Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma scores become 1, as its mind is fully shattered.

The creature can't cast spells, activate magic items, understand language, or communicate in any intelligible way, and even its instincts become dulled, only retaining basic desires such as wanting to eat or sleep. The creature can, however, identify its friends, follow them, and even protect them. When casting this spell, you may also impose a specific goal for the now brainless creature, in which they will do the best they can to pursue such a goal.

On the case of no goal being given, they are filled with an imeasurable void, taking one point of exhaustion every day at midnight as their mind degrades in its search for any purpose. The spell can only be ended by heal or wish.

spell.name: Fear of God [Cleric Only]
entries: There are times where the only right thing to do is to remind others of their mortality, of how even when simply tapped into, the power of a divinity will tear a soul asunder and spit it out. You teach others the fear of god. As an action, you raise your hand and a finger up in the air, spending an action in subsequent turns to raise another.

At raising your hand, any creature inside this area feels the ground shake violently and perceives the sky turning red, with dark clouds gathering around. For each finger that is raised, a different effect occurs in that round, as described below. You are immune to these effects, and failed saving throws still cause creatures to take half the damage rolled.

entries.caption: Fear of God Table
colLabels: A Plague to Render Faithlessness Into Oblivion
rows: {@b Maelstrom Edict.} The heavy clouds in the sky start plummeting all the area in a heavy tempest. All creatures in the area must pass a Dexterity Saving throw or take {@damage 4d8} bludgeoning damage and have their movement speed reduced by 20 feet until the end of their next turn.

{@b Floods Edict.} From the downpour's waters a mighty whirlpool starts forming below your feet, all creatures within the area must pass a Strength saving throw or take {@damage 8d8} cold damage from the freezing waters plummeting them, also being knocked {@condition Prone} on failure.

{@b Disease Edict.} You cause the waters to turn foul and filled with disease, all creatures within the area must pass a Constitution Saving Throw or suffer from the {@condition Poisoned} condition until healed through a Restoration spell or similar, more powerful means. This ignores immunity, as divine cells slowly corrode the body instead of a normal sickness.

{@b Blazing Edict.} The diseased water suddenly turns gooey and dark like oil, soon bursting in an inferno of white flame. All creatures inside must pass an Intelligence Saving Throw or suffer from the flames finding a home in their eyes, giving them the {@condition Blinded} condition until healed through means like the edict above, also having them take {@damage 6d8} radiant damage.

{@b Edict of Shadow.} The flames vanish in the blink of an eye, yet the shadows they cast remain, quickly scurrying inside any unlocked door, window or other passageway. Any creature within 30-feet of a passageway inside the spells area must pass a Wisdom Saving Throw or be grasped and pierced by shadow hands that induce waking nightmares into their brains, having them take {@damage 6d4} necrotic damage and suffer the effects of {@spell bane|PHB|Bane} until cured by the means above.

{@b Insignificance Edict.} You finish the spell by clasping both hands together in prayer. All corpses within the area explode in white fire, any creature within 10-feet of a corpse must make a Charisma Saving Throw or take {@damage 3d8} psychic damage per corpse that exploded in a 10-feet range of them, as the reminder of their insignificance in the grand scheme of things dawns on them.

entries: After casting this spell, your index finger is burnt in radiant light. You take {@damage 4d12} radiant light as this scars your body, so not even you may forget this lesson of Faith.

spell.name: Step Through Heaven's Door
entries: In a moments notice, you clap your hands and have your body transferred to another point within reach, as if you had simply taken a step from a room to another. When you cast this spell, you are teleported instantly to any empty 5-feet space of which you've seen before. You may also choose to spend your reaction in addition to your action to cast this spell as a reaction to failing a Strength or Dexterity Saving Throw, potentially saving yourself from its consequences.
At Higher Levels: When cast with every second spell slot level above 5th ( 7th and 9th ), this spell's range increases by one mile.

spell.name: Prayer of Wholeness

components.m: A holy symbol of a deity

entries: A little trust in your deity goes far, as long as they respond. When you cast this spell choose up to three creatures within range to be healed by {@damage 8d8+8} hit points and then roll a d100, on a result below 20 nothing happens, between 21-40 the targets are healed by half that amount, between 41-80 the targets are healed by the normal result and above 81 they are healed by double the hit points that would be restored.

spell.name: Make Fearless
entries: You let out a wave of magic to wash over your allies, emboldening them to keep fighting the good fight no matter what. Choose up to five friendly creatures including yourself within the spells range, these creatures gain a +1 bonus to hit and to their Armor Class for the next three rounds, also being granted 15 temporary hit points. At Higher Levels: The value of the bonuses to hit and to AC are increased by a further +1 for each third level above 3rd, such as 6th and 9th level.
The amount of temporary hit points gained also increases by 5.

spell.name: Shattering Smite
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon is enveloped by your very own aura, causing it to ripple against any surface - creating cracks and fissures with ease. On your next hit you deal an additional {@damage 2d4} thunder damage and 2 {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} counts.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the thunder damage dealt by the attack increases by {@dice 1d4} and you deal an additional count of {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Bloodbath for a Throne
entries: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon nearly shatters on your grip as pure divine power flows through it, causing you to deal an additional {@damage 2d8} radiant damage on a hit and forcing all hostile creatures within 10-ft of the initial hit target to pass a Constitution Saving Throw or take the same amount of damage. For any creature that is killed or knocked {@condition Unconscious||Unconscious} from this damage, all hostile creatures within range suffer an additional {@damage 2d8} radiant damage and then are inflicted with 4 {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} count, as the space around you crackles and breaks.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the radiant damage dealt by all effects increases by {@dice 1d8} and you deal an additional 2 counts of {@condition Rupture|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Magic Bullet Fire

components.m: a piece of ammunition kissed by a devil

entries: You insert a piece of ranged ammunition into a ranged weapon, infusing it with pure, violent magic through a magic circle that appears at the barrel or point of your weapon. You then shoot in a direction of your choice, covering a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long line as the bullet explodes in a nearly blinding flash, never truly missing its target. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 1d10} force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d10} for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Ticking Clockhand
entries: {@i Chronurgy cantrip.}

You fling an ethereal clock hand toward a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, it takes {@damage 1d6} piercing damage and suffers 2 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.
The spell's damage increases by {@damage 1d6} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d6}), 11th level ({@damage 3d6}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d6}).

spell.name: Undo Locomotion
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

With a touch, you fling a creature backward through its timestream, causing its body to return to a space it occupied within the last 12 seconds. It appears in the nearest unoccupied space if the original space is obstructed or occupied. Its body defies gravity if the original space remains reachable, causing it to fall if it has no footing. An unwilling target can make a Constitution saving throw, suffering no effect on a success.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can touch one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Chronal Disruption
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

You target a creature within range and plunge it outside its timestream for a moment, causing it to feel as if it were pricked by pins. The target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes {@damage 3d6} bludgeoning damage, suffers 4 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, and loses either its next bonus action or its next reaction, chosen by you. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and suffers half as much {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, rounded down.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@damage 1d6} and the {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} increases by 1 for each slot level above 2nd. Both are halved on a successful saving throw.

spell.name: Dead-Air Sphere
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

You summon a monochromatic sphere around a point you can see within range, encompassing a 30-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has its perception of time cut out for a brief second, suffers 6 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, and then suffers a {@variantrule Tremor Burst|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}. On a successful save, it suffers half as much {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, rounded down.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} increases by 2 for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Metronome Modal
entries: {@i Chronurgy spell.}

You summon a magic circle with a 30-foot radius centered on a point of your choice within range. A clock hand pierces the ground at its center, shifting from side to side on initiative count 20. Starting with the turn the spell is cast, the metronome alternates from Odd to Even, producing the following effects for every creature within the circle:

entries.name: Tick (Odd Turns)
entries: All damage taken is reduced by {@dice 2d4} after it is rolled.

entries.name: Tock (Even Turns)
entries: All damage dealt increases by {@damage 1d6} bludgeoning damage, and each creature inflicts 1 {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules} on a hit.

Once per turn while the spell is active, when a creature hits another creature within the circle, you can use your reaction to cause the target to suffer a {@variantrule Tremor Burst|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: For every two spell slot levels above 4th, creatures within the circle inflict 1 additional {@condition Tremor|TheUndertomesGeneralRules}, and the circle's radius increases by 10 feet.

spell.name: Mind Lasher

components.m: a chain wrapped around your hand

entries: You produce a heavy spectral chain buzzing with purple energy. Make a melee spell attack against a target within range. On a hit, it takes {@damage 1d8} + your spellcasting ability modifier in psychic damage.
The damage increases by {@damage 1d8} and the range changes when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d8}, 20 feet), 11th level ({@damage 3d8}, 25 feet), and 17th level ({@damage 4d8}, 30 feet).

entries.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When cast using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the target is covered in gashes that deal the same number of damage dice it took from the spell, plus an additional {@damage 2d8} psychic damage for every two slot levels above 2nd.

spell.name: Doombox Aura
entries: You summon an aura of living music in a 30-foot radius around yourself that moves with you. Choose any style of music. At the end of each of your turns, every glass, metal, or crystal object in the aura takes {@damage 4d6} thunder damage.

entries.name: Play It Loud
entries: As a bonus action after casting the spell, you can tune the music to force creatures of your choice in the aura to make a Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

entries.name: Signature Track
entries: Alternatively, the spell deals no damage to objects, and you gain a +2 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) and Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) checks and a +3 bonus to Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks while the music plays.

entries.name: At Higher Levels
